digest.component_or_area: rebar lifecycle verification and policy gates
propositions: Enable both verify.enforce_plan_material_pins and verify.require_plan_review_for_close policies in rebar.toml configuration while keeping library defaults false

Prove integrated lifecycle behavior through public-surface end-to-end test scenarios covering legacy unpinned attestations, enforcement state transitions, transitive invalidation, and re-review idempotence
Verify that stale material-pin drift rejection and missing plan-review close gates produce correct exit codes, status preservation, and user-facing remediation guidance
Demonstrate that depends_on and blocks references normalize to a single canonical prerequisite pin, and that execution-time self-edits plus return-to-open resets maintain correct validity state
Ensure no eager backfill, graph-wide invalidation events, new commands, list-output changes, or stored relation migrations are introduced by policy enablement
